يرتبك (form VIII)
# يَرْتَبِكُ (yartabiku) /jar.ta.bi.ku/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَبَكَ (irtabaka)
# يَرْتَبِكَ (yartabika) /jar.ta.bi.ka/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَبَكَ (irtabaka)
# يَرْتَبِكْ (yartabik) /jar.ta.bik/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِرْتَبَكَ (irtabaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
